name: Beim Hochfilzer: Hotel & Premium-Chalets
beschreibung: The hotel Beim Hochfilzer: Hotel & Premium-Chalets is situated in the very center of Söll, a charming and historic village in the Tyrolean Unterland. Guests can easily reach the Bergbahnen Söll mountain lifts on foot, providing seamless ski-in, ski-out access to the vast Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. The accommodation blends alpine elegance with a relaxed, welcoming ambiance. Lodging options include stylish rooms in the main building as well as spacious premium chalets designed for exclusive privacy and comfort.
